sentences.en: Like I, whenever I have the photos of that day, I still see myself sitting on the chair with my diploma in my hand, looking super, super proud.

sentences.en: Oh, wow.

sentences.en: Even now, when I think of that day, my heart is like feeling a deep pain because I'm not sure that I can feel that excitement ever and ever again.

sentences.en: And I know that the girls in my school, they also miss that day very, very badly.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道我学校的女孩们也非常非常怀念那一天。
